question: An engineer must diagnose intermittent latency and slow response-time issues in the fabric using Cisco DCNM. Which sequence of features must be used to perform a slow-drain analysis?
options: Slow Drain Analysis / Duration Once/Run Immediately / Start/Stop Collection / Current Jobs/Result
Current Jobs/Result / Start/Stop Collection / Duration Once/Run Immediately / Slow Drain Analysis
Slow Drain Analysis / Start/Stop Collection / Duration Once/Run Immediately / Current Jobs/Result
Duration Once/Run Immediately / Slow Drain Analysis / Start/Stop Collection / Current Jobs/Result
theory: DCNM's slow-drain analysis workflow is used in a fixed sequence: you launch the Slow Drain Analysis feature, choose the collection duration (a one-time 'Once' run or continuous 'Run Immediately' monitoring), then start (and later stop) the data collection job, and finally review the outcome under Current Jobs/Results - following this order is what lets you diagnose intermittent latency caused by slow-draining devices in the fabric. (Cisco DCNM SAN Insights documentation / web research)
